name: İzmir
meta_description: TDSC investigative consulting in matters touching İzmir: exporter and free zone due diligence, agri-commodity checks and dispute support on the Aegean coast.
hero_lede: İzmir is Türkiye's third city and the commercial capital of the Aegean, an export hub for manufactured goods, figs, raisins and cotton, and home to the Aegean Free Zone. TDSC scopes investigative consulting for matters running through the city from Nashville, coordinating Turkish counsel and qualified local professionals where needed.
intro: İzmir is Türkiye's third most populous city, with 4,493,242 residents in the province at the end of 2024 according to TÜİK, and the economic centre of the Aegean region, which it dominates with roughly half of regional output. The province has five active ports, at Alsancak in the city centre, Aliağa, Dikili, Çandarlı and Çeşme, and an international airport. Its economy combines manufacturing for export, agriculture and agri-processing, logistics and tourism. The Aegean Free Zone at Gaziemir, operated by ESBAŞ, exported about USD 3 billion in 2024, around 22 percent of the province's USD 13.6 billion in exports, and the İzmir Commodity Exchange is the country's oldest commodity exchange.

Organisations commission investigative work connected to İzmir because it is where many Aegean exporters, agricultural traders and contract manufacturers are based and financed. European buyers of dried fruit, cotton, olive oil, textiles and industrial components need assurance about who owns their suppliers and where goods really originate. Investors in free zone manufacturers, lenders to family-owned exporters and parties in trade disputes all need reliable information about İzmir companies and their owners. The port and free zone also make the city a transit point whose trading companies warrant review for customs, origin and sanctions exposure, particularly where goods are re-exported.

matters.title: Aegean exporter and supplier diligence
matters.text: Buyers sourcing textiles, machinery parts, processed food and building materials from İzmir verify ownership, production capacity, subcontracting, financial condition and litigation of exporters and their family owners before contracting, renewing major supply agreements or extending payment terms.

matters.title: Agri-commodity origin and quality disputes
matters.text: Figs, sultana raisins, cotton and olive products traded through İzmir carry geographical indications and quality standards. Disputes over origin, adulteration, short delivery or contract default call for research into the trader, its suppliers, warehousing and history with other buyers.

matters.title: Free zone company reviews
matters.text: Companies in the Aegean Free Zone benefit from customs and tax advantages and trade heavily with Europe. Investors, acquirers and customers review ownership, export performance, related-party flows and compliance history, and check whether goods processed in the zone have been re-exported to restricted destinations.

matters.title: Port-linked trading intermediaries
matters.text: Trading and forwarding companies using İzmir's ports may sit between European goods and buyers in the Middle East, North Africa and the Black Sea region. Engagements examine ownership, banking, shipping patterns and counterparties to assess sanctions, export control and diversion exposure.

matters.title: Dispute and enforcement support
matters.text: Claims against İzmir companies are typically heard in the city's commercial courts. Investigative support locates witnesses and documents for counsel, then researches real estate, company interests and transfers to relatives or affiliates that bear on enforcing a judgment or award in the province.

local_context.title: Commercial courts in İzmir
local_context.text: Commercial disputes involving İzmir companies, including receivables, compensation claims, breach of contract, unfair competition and shareholder disputes, generally go to the commercial courts of first instance (asliye ticaret) at the İzmir courthouse. Mediation is a precondition for certain commercial claims before a lawsuit can be filed. Appeals go to the regional court of appeal serving İzmir. National procedural and arbitration rules are covered on our Türkiye page.

local_context.title: İzmir Commodity Exchange
local_context.text: The İzmir Commodity Exchange (İTB) is described as the oldest and most active commodity exchange in Türkiye and is where agricultural and food products from the Aegean are registered and traded. It led registration of geographical indications for Aegean Sultani Grape, Aegean Cotton and Aegean Fig. Its trading and registration activity is relevant background in commodity origin, pricing and quality disputes.

local_context.title: Aegean Free Zone (ESBAŞ)
local_context.text: The Aegean Free Zone in Gaziemir is operated by ESBAŞ. In 2024 its companies recorded about USD 6 billion in trade and USD 3 billion in exports, roughly a quarter of the exports of Türkiye's 19 free zones. Zone companies operate under customs and tax incentives tied to export performance, so their ownership, related parties and trade flows are frequent subjects of diligence by investors and customers.

local_context.title: Chamber and company records
local_context.text: İzmir companies are registered with the trade registry office in the province, and registered events such as incorporation, capital changes and director appointments are announced in the Turkish Trade Registry Gazette. The İzmir Chamber of Commerce is the main business body for company formation and membership. Local business press and the chamber's membership information supplement registry data when reconstructing an İzmir company's history.

tdsc_approach: For İzmir matters TDSC first establishes whether the relevant entities sit in the city, in the Aegean Free Zone, in organised industrial areas elsewhere in the province, or in Istanbul holding structures. Every counterparty and trade flow is screened for sanctions and export control exposure before research begins. Work draws on Trade Registry Gazette announcements, court information available through lawful means, commodity exchange and free zone publications, and Turkish-language Aegean business press, reviewed by Turkish speakers. Where factory visits, interviews or document retrieval are needed, TDSC coordinates qualified local professionals under the direction of the client's Turkish counsel, mindful of Türkiye's strict personal data rules and the absence of an identified investigator licensing regime.

faqs.q: How significant is İzmir in Turkish exports?
faqs.a: İzmir exported about USD 13.6 billion in 2024 and is the leading exporter of the Aegean region. Its exports span manufactured goods, machinery parts, textiles and agricultural products such as figs, raisins, cotton and olive oil, and around 22 percent come from companies in the Aegean Free Zone.

faqs.q: What is the Aegean Free Zone?
faqs.a: It is a free zone at Gaziemir in İzmir, operated by ESBAŞ, where companies manufacture and trade with customs and tax advantages linked to exporting. In 2024 its companies exported about USD 3 billion, roughly a quarter of all exports from Türkiye's 19 free zones.

faqs.q: Where are disputes with İzmir companies heard?
faqs.a: Commercial claims generally go to the commercial courts of first instance at the İzmir courthouse, with appeals to the regional court of appeal serving the city. For certain commercial claims, mediation must be attempted before a lawsuit is filed. Many international contracts instead provide for arbitration, often seated in Istanbul.

faqs.q: Can TDSC verify the origin of Aegean agricultural products?
faqs.a: TDSC can research the trader, its suppliers, processing and storage facilities, export history and disputes with other buyers, using registry data, exchange information, court records and press. Laboratory testing and certification remain matters for accredited bodies, and findings are reported alongside any gaps in documentation.

faqs.q: Does TDSC have an office in İzmir?
faqs.a: No. TDSC is based in Nashville, Tennessee and has no office or staff in Türkiye. Engagements touching İzmir are scoped and managed from Nashville. Where local work is required, TDSC coordinates qualified Turkish professionals and works with the client's Turkish counsel, and field work is never presented as TDSC's own.
